item.title: Weekly Threat Summary — 2026-10-06 — Cyber Threat Wall Weekly intelligence brief
item.description: Threat Signal —. CISA added 6 actively exploited vulnerabilities during the last 7 days. Other is the most represented technology category among this week's new KEVs (4). Zammad GmbH has the most new KEV entries this week (2). CVE-2026-81578 is the largest 7-day rank riser, up 644 positions.
